source: User pasted questionnaire answers; original Yes/No/Undecided preserved. See decision register for interpretation.

answers.question: If two matching applications already have different case numbers, should the first-created case number remain the shared case number?
answers.context: Keep the other number as a permanent historical reference pointing to the retained case; preserve both submissions and payments.

answers.question: Should CTM check for an existing matching marriage before allocating a new case number at submission?
answers.context: Use the confirmed exact marriage-date plus both-birth-dates rule. Recheck when submission commits so simultaneous filings cannot create duplicate shared cases.
answers.clarification:
either option works
even when putting a date of birth.. it can be wrong date of birth... and this is why we have both options of certificate # and/or birthdate

answers.question: If the exact dates match more than one existing marriage record, should automatic linking pause for admin or secretary review?
answers.context: This covers exceptional collisions and historical duplicates. No random choice between matching cases.

answers.question: If a spouse birth date is unknown, should automatic linking remain unavailable until admin or secretary verifies the case association?
answers.context: The applicant can still submit using the approved Unknown allowances. This does not make a missing date match another missing date.
answers.clarification: even when putting a date of birth.. it can be wrong date of birth... and this is why we have both options of certificate # and/or birthdate

answers.question: Should later changes to marriage date or birth dates leave an established case link unchanged unless admin or secretary explicitly corrects the association?
answers.context: Preserve both source answers and the association history; do not silently move a submitted application to another case.

answers.question: If applications were linked to the wrong case, may admin or secretary correct the association while preserving every original number, submission, payment and audit event?
answers.context: This is a controlled correction, not deletion or automatic merging of two people. Describe any additional approval you require.

answers.question: When matching submissions have the same two birth dates, should ambiguous applicant-versus-spouse identity require staff review before activating access?
answers.context: A marriage match identifies the shared case; it must not assign one applicant the other person’s submissions. This matters especially if both spouses share a birth date.

answers.question: Should adding an unregistered second party send an email asking them to register and verify that same email?
answers.context: The confirmed pending case association activates after registration and verification; no separate Accept Invitation step.
answers.clarification: email asking them to register is acceptable only if its coming in from the admin or secretary or case manager

answers.question: May admin or secretary correct or cancel a pending second-party email association before it activates?
answers.context: Keep the original entry and changes in audit history. A cancelled or replaced address must not later activate that old association.

answers.question: Once an account is linked, should changing that account’s email keep its case connections unchanged?
answers.context: The new address still requires verification under the confirmed account rules. This avoids treating an email change as a new person.

answers.question: After the second party is linked, should they complete their own regular application if they wish to file a petition?
answers.context: Each actual filer pays USD 250; merely joining/responding does not itself incur a filing fee. Portal layout and detailed experience remain for later.

answers.question: Should returning an incomplete application immediately send its correction instructions privately through the portal and email?
answers.context: The same case number, no second fee, required reviewer explanation and preserved submissions are already confirmed.

answers.question: Should resubmission place the application back in the completeness-review queue and notify admin and secretary?
answers.context: This does not allocate a case number or charge again.

answers.question: Should the first accepted application allow the shared case to reach the assignment agenda even if the other party’s application is still being completed or returned?
answers.context: Keep the second application’s review state separate from the shared case’s assignment state.

answers.question: If a spouse already has a different open case, should adding/linking them to this case pause for admin or secretary review?
answers.context: Always preserve the one-open-case-per-applicant rule. No override or silent closure of the other case.
answers.clarification: different open case as in differen marriage... this should not be possible...  but if it happens yes.. this needs to be altered

answers.question: For Declaration of Nullity with permission to remarry granted, should both parties be entitled to the decree certificate?
answers.context: They still need explicit admin/secretary release before seeing it. Answer No and explain if entitlement varies.
answers.clarification:
yes but only if the admin / secretary releases.  Otherwise its a notification of the decree given
there is a workflow of how this decree certificate is given to be given at a later time

answers.question: For conditional permission to remarry, should the decision explicitly identify the entitled party or parties and state the conditions?
answers.context: Do not infer certificate entitlement from the word conditional alone.

answers.question: Should a conditional decree be issuable and close the case while its stated conditions remain requirements for future remarriage?
answers.context: This asks whether CTM needs to track fulfilment before issuance. It does not change the separate future marriage ecosystem.

answers.question: Should later appeal decrees use A2, A3 and so on for successive appeal proceedings that produce a decree?
answers.context: A1 is already confirmed for the first appeal decree. Two applicants’ appeals heard together are not two numbering rounds.

answers.question: After a new appeal decree is issued, should the earlier decree stay accessible until admin or secretary explicitly changes its release access?
answers.context: Appeal submission alone already leaves access unchanged. This asks specifically about the later new decree.

answers.question: Should signed decision notices, when required by the institution, use separate templates from decree certificates?
answers.context: If notices never need a signature, choose No and say so. This does not add a decree to Petition Denied.
answers.clarification: a decree is a certicicate issed by teh diocese of los angeles

answers.question: Should a physical signature date be recorded separately from the later scan-upload and issuance timestamps?
answers.context: The actual uploader must not be represented as the signer; no invented historical signature dates.
answers.clarification: its either, digital signature and date or physically signed signature and date that is uploaded.

answers.question: If another case is open for an applicant, should appeal acceptance be blocked until that conflict is resolved by admin or secretary?
answers.context: Reopening can never produce two open cases for the same person. Do not silently close the newer case or discard the appeal.

answers.question: If one applicant’s appeal reopens the case while the other has an unfinished appeal draft, should submission of that draft pause until the case is closed again?
answers.context: Keep the existing draft; do not charge for a submission that cannot proceed. Clarify if it should instead become information in the reopened case.
answers.clarification: anyone can submit an appeal at anytime... each party is independnet.

answers.question: After council declines an appeal, should the applicant be able to file another appeal supported by new information, even if no new case closure occurred?
answers.context: Repeat appeals after later closure are confirmed. This covers a decline that never reopened the case.

answers.question: After an applicant withdraws a pending appeal, may they file another appeal with a new USD 250 fee while the original case remains closed?
answers.context: Preserve the withdrawn application/payment. This is a new filing, not restoring or refunding the old one.

answers.question: May admin save historical entries as work in progress before publishing them as council-visible case records?
answers.context: These are staff data-entry records, not applicant drafts. Choose No if each save should be council-visible immediately.

answers.question: Should admin explicitly confirm whether a historical case is open or closed when finalizing its entry?
answers.context: No invented dates or decisions for missing historical details; known open cases still consume the open-case claim.

answers.question: Should an original historical decree number be preserved instead of replacing it with the new DCR format?
answers.context: The historical case and applicant identifiers already retain original values where available.
answers.clarification: but any old decrees must be voided and noted voided.  there can only be 1 decree at any given time

answers.question: Should an uploaded historical signed decree require the same explicit release before the applicant can access it?
answers.context: Linking a verified account to historical records must not automatically expose a certificate.

answers.question: May admin or secretary fix historical transcription mistakes after finalization, preserving the original entered value and every correction?
answers.context: This is a proposed narrow data-entry correction exception, not permission to change a historical ruling or its signed document.

answers.question: May admin or secretary edit the English and Arabic system-message templates, preserving every version and the exact text previously sent?
answers.context: Includes hearing updates, invitations, appeal notices and certificate availability. No retroactive changes to sent messages.

answers.question: Should a failed email delivery be visible to admin and secretary so they can correct the contact issue or retry it?
answers.context: Keep the portal message and delivery history; a failed email must not undo a committed case action.

answers.question: Should the applicant’s assigned-member change notification go through both the portal and email?
answers.context: Applicants seeing the assigned member name and receiving a change notification are confirmed; specify both channels here.

answers.question: For testimony larger than 100 MB, should CTM support consecutive recording parts, each within the 100 MB limit?
answers.context: One testimony event can have multiple ordered audio files and a continuous transcript timeline. No loss of previously recorded parts.
answers.clarification: no limit. we need a open source audio recording addon.

answers.question: When testimony is rescheduled, should the previous Confirm/Reject response remain in history and a fresh response be requested for the changed appointment?
answers.context: The affected applicant already receives the updated private portal/email invitation.

answers.question: May admin or secretary correct AI speaker labels and map them to the actual applicant or council member, retaining the AI original and change history?
answers.context: Timestamps and labels are already required. This is attribution correction, not voice-based identity proof.

answers.question: If AI transcription or translation fails, should testimony remain usable from its saved audio while admin or secretary can retry processing?
answers.context: Failure must not erase the recording or fabricate a completed transcript.

answers.question: Should admin or secretary be able to review the AI transcript and translation before those generated texts appear to other council members?
answers.context: Source audio remains council-only as agreed. Choose No for immediate council access clearly marked AI-generated.
